## Changes
- **Backup Catalogue, on the File menu.** Your safety copy has a window of its own: choose the folder (with how much room its drive has), copy the catalogue now or each time the app closes, see the copies kept, and restore from them.
- **Mirror all data shows how it's getting on.** Before copying it says how many files are new or changed and how big they are. While it runs you see how far it has got, the files and gigabytes copied, the speed now and on average, how long is left, how many files were already up to date, the room left on the drive, any problems and the file being copied. Stop keeps what's copied, and mirroring again carries on from there. Settings › Storage's Mirror button opens the same window.
